{{Quote|Unlike the average Riorian, Stalnus evidently never learned to settle disputes with anything but a vibroaxe.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="Wanted by Cracken" />}}
'''Riorians''' were an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]]<ref name="TFU II" /> [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rior/Legends|Rior]]. They were characterized by their large, [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and sensitive [[Ear/Legends|hearing]]. While most were peaceful, a maniacal [[Gender/Legends|male]] Riorian known as [[Stalnus]] was wanted for [[Death|murder]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Wanted by Cracken" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="7 ABY">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] dates itself to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. As ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], including the Battle of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], it can be assumed that ''Wanted by Cracken'' takes place in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> In addition, at least one Riorian was a member of the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]].<ref name="Criminal Organizations">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
While [[Leland Chee]], keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]], initially confirmed that [[Loje Nella/Legends|Loje Nella]] was a Riorian,<ref name="Riorian">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=01200#16270670|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-02-06|time=3:45 PM|quote=Loje Nella is actually a Riorian, since the Rioirian image shown in the RPG Wanted by Cracken is Ep VI concept art for the character referred to by production as the Toadstool Terror.}}</ref> he later debated whether this was truly accurate and said that the identity of her species should be determined in a future source.<ref name="Or Not">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1213|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|nobackup=1}}</ref> Ultimately, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', a three-volume encyclopedia edited by [[Bob Vitas]]<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and released on [[December 9]], [[2008]],<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> confirmed that Nella was an "intelligent [[Cliffborer worm|cliff-borer worm]]."<ref name="Nella, Loje">{{CSWECite|II|369|text=Nella, Loje}}</ref>
